positions.name: QuantumDbMigrationDecision
positions.frame: what are the parameters and rationale driving the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration decision?
positions.why: Dave Quantum's assertion of the switch with 10x performance and lower cost (src-1) is restated and decomposed by Xena's structured summary into the migration itself (src-2), the performance gain (src-3), and the timeline (src-4). All four cohere under one directional read: the defining parameters of the database migration decision — what, why, and when.
